metadata.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq and Dow drop as oil and bond yields surge and mega-tech earnings disappoint - MarketWatch

content.text:
6 min ago
S&P 500, Nasdaq and Dow drop as oil and bond yields surge and mega-tech earnings disappoint
Stocks opened sharply lower as investors were stung by number of negative catalysts.
Surging oil prices and Treasury yields led to worries that the Federal Reserve would raise interest rates sooner than expected, potentially as early as next week. And the first earnings reports by members of the group of megacap tech names known as the Magnificent Seven — Tesla and Alphabet — disappointed investors, sending their stocks falling.
The S&P 500 was dropping 0.9% to 7,433, putting it on track for its lowest close since June 26.
The Nasdaq composite was sinking 1.7% to 25,262, putting it on track for its biggest one-day decline since it fell 2.2% on June 23.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average was losing 410 points, or 0.8%, to 51,808, toward its lowest close since June 23.
